standard.summary: PCGrad（Projecting Conflicting Gradients）检测并解决多任务/多概念训练中的梯度冲突——当两个概念的梯度方向相反时，投影掉冲突分量。
standard.effect: 减少概念之间的互相干扰。pcgrad_conflict_threshold 控制什么程度的负余弦相似度被判定为冲突。
standard.whenToUse: 多概念训练中概念互相干扰严重时（学了 A 忘了 B）。
standard.avoidWhen: 单概念训练时不需要。计算开销较大（需要计算梯度间的余弦相似度矩阵）。

standard_en.summary: PCGrad (Projecting Conflicting Gradients) detects and resolves gradient conflicts in multi-task/multi-concept training -- when two concepts' gradients point in opposite directions, the conflicting component is projected out.
standard_en.effect: It reduces interference between concepts. pcgrad_conflict_threshold decides how negative the cosine similarity has to be to count as a conflict.
standard_en.whenToUse: In multi-concept training when the concepts interfere badly (learning A makes it forget B).
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not needed in single-concept training. It costs a fair amount of compute (a cosine-similarity matrix between gradients has to be computed).

advanced.principle: 对每个 LoRA 层的梯度，计算其与其他层梯度的余弦相似度。如果 cos(g_i, g_j) < threshold（冲突），将 g_i 投影到 g_j 的法平面上：g_i' = g_i - (g_i·g_j / ||g_j||²) * g_j。这消除了冲突方向的分量。pcgrad_reduction='mean' 对所有冲突投影取平均。
advanced.intervention: 在 optimizer.step() 前对梯度做 PCGrad 投影。
advanced.expectedImpact: 多概念训练中减少概念干扰约 10-20%。单概念训练无效果。
advanced.tradeoffs: 计算开销随 LoRA 层数平方增长。大模型上可能需要限制投影范围。

advanced_en.principle: For each LoRA layer's gradient, compute cosine similarity against the other layers' gradients. If cos(g_i, g_j) < threshold (conflict), project g_i onto the normal plane of g_j: g_i' = g_i - (g_i·g_j / ||g_j||²) * g_j, removing the conflicting direction's component. pcgrad_reduction='mean' averages over all conflict projections.
advanced_en.intervention: Applies PCGrad projection to gradients before optimizer.step().
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Reduces concept interference by roughly 10-20% in multi-concept training. No effect for single-concept training.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Compute cost grows with the square of the LoRA layer count. On large models you may need to limit the projection scope.
